```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library("thief")
library(forecast)
library(lubridate)
library(tidyverse)
library(zoltr)
library(covidHubUtils)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=15, fig.height=8}
func_list <- list.files(path = "../R", pattern=".R", full.names=TRUE)
lapply(func_list, source)

full_hosp_truth <- load_truth("HealthData", 
                         "inc hosp", 
                         temporal_resolution="daily",
                         data_location = "remote_hub_repo")

start_date = as.Date("2020-07-27"); end_date = as.Date("2021-05-03")
pi_levels = c(10 * (1:9), 95, 98)

test <- aggregate_thief_df(full_hosp_truth, ts_col = "value", start_date, end_date, fips_code = "48", aggregate_levels = list(56, 28, 14, 7, 1), frequency = 56) 
plot_thief_agg(test, start_date)
temp <- compute_base_forecasts(test, pi_levels)
temp_reconciled <- reconcilethief(temp, aggregatelist = agg_list) # produces a warning

extended_test <- extended_truth_data(full_hosp_truth, ts_col = "value", start_date, end_date, fips_code, aggregate_levels = list(56, 28, 14, 7, 1), frequency = 56)
dates_test <- get_ts_dates(start_date, end_date, frequency = 56) 
plot_thief(base_forecasts= temp, reconciled_forecasts= temp_reconciled, ts_dates = dates_test, extended_truth = extended_test) 
temp_rec_df <- transform_to_hub_df(temp_reconciled, end_date, "48", pi_levels)

hub_test <- thief_wrapper(full_hosp_truth, ts_col = "value", 
  start_date, end_date, fips_code = "48",
  aggregate_levels = list(56, 28, 14, 7, 1), frequency = 56,
  pi_levels = pi_levels,
  plot.aggregates = TRUE, plot.forecasts = TRUE)
```

```{r}
full_hosp_truth %>%
  filter(location == "48", 
    target_end_date %in% c(start_date:end_date)) %>%
  select(target_end_date, value) %>%
  plot()
```
